name: claudiaagent.world
about: Claudia, the open character from the music videos ESCAPE VELOCITY, CLODYSSEY and BLISS: every Midjourney image and prompt, the films, and how to make her yourself, for people and agents.
credit: Directed by anabology; made with Claude, Midjourney, Seedance and Suno. Fan work about Claude; not affiliated with Anthropic.
use: Claudia is an open character: anyone may make work with her. A credit ('Claudia by anabology') is appreciated, not required. See /use/.

item_fields.prompt: the Midjourney prompt as it ran
item_fields.params: parameters as they ran, without the director's personal profile
item_fields.profile: true if it ran with the director's personal profile
item_fields.plate: true if this image is a plate in the finished film (EV: recovered by matching the cut)
item_fields.cut: picked but its shot was cut
item_fields.edited: the plate was corrected with an image-edit model
item_fields.verdict: the director's verdict in CLODYSSEY's storyboard review: pick | reject | comment
item_fields.framing: ECU, CU, MCU, MS, MWS, full, WS, EWS, aerial, macro, sheet
item_fields.url: s, m and full image files
